zh.title: 聯合航空於休士頓長程航線波音787-9客機減少35個座位
zh.summary: 聯合航空調整波音787-9客機配置；客艙總座位減少35席；提升高階艙位服務
body: 聯合航空（United Airlines）計畫調整其波音（Boeing）787-9 Dreamliner客艙配置，在其執飛休士頓長程航線的該型客機上減少35個座位。該項客艙重組將直接影響聯合航空自休士頓出發的長途國際航班客艙佈局。
客艙座位數量的減少將使該型客機的整體載客容量降低，但同時將增加收益更為豐厚的高階艙位產品供應。業者透過此項調整，旨在提升長途航線的高端客艙服務品質與整體收益。
相關產業紀錄顯示，波音787-9客機為2026年交付量領先的寬體客機。其新機交付同時也在加速部分航空公司淘汰三款較舊型號的客機。

en.title: United Airlines Removes 35 Seats From Boeing 787-9 Aircraft On Houston Long-Haul Routes
en.summary: United Airlines removes 35 seats on Boeing 787-9 Houston routes; overall capacity decreases while premium offerings expand
body: United Airlines is deliberately removing 35 seats from its Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner aircraft operating on long-haul routes out of Houston. The seating modification adjusts the cabin layout for long-haul operations.

Although removing the seats reduces overall seating capacity on the aircraft, it expands premium offerings on these routes. The operational adjustment focuses on increasing lucrative premium seating capacity for passengers on long-haul flights.

According to verified industry records, the Boeing 787-9 is leading widebody aircraft deliveries in 2026. Deliveries of the Boeing 787-9 model are also accelerating the retirement of three older aircraft types across four airlines.
